question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Rebarbative
solution:
The correct answer is: **Attractive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Rebarbative"** refers to something that is unattractive, repellent, or irritating in nature. (अप्रिय/विकर्षक)
 
 
• **Example: **The rebarbative behavior of the manager made the employees feel uncomfortable.
 
 
 
• **"Attractive"** is the opposite of rebarbative. It refers to something that is pleasing, appealing, or charming. (आकर्षक)
 
 
• **Example: **The beautiful scenery of the mountains was highly attractive to the tourists.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the antonym of **'Rebarbative' **is **'Attractive'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Attractive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Repulsive **(घृणास्पद): Something that causes a strong feeling of disgust or aversion.
 
 
• **Example:** The smell of the garbage was absolutely repulsive.
 
 
 
• **Off-putting **(अरुचिकर): Something that is unpleasant, disconcerting, or causing dislike.
 
 
• **Example: **His off-putting attitude made it difficult to work with him.
 
 
 
• **Irritating** (चिड़चिड़ा): Something that causes annoyance or discomfort.
 
 
• **Example:** The constant noise from the construction site was very irritating.
